notes.title: Patch 1.2.0

Difficulties were rebalanced
Slide now has invincibility frames
Alternative mode for Mercifulness (dash) now can be performed in air
More hands to grab!
Some graphical and text updates

It’s recommended to start a new save in order to avoid graphical inconsistencies

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.2
-Grabbing skill is now available from the start.
-Some levels were redesigned with grabbing being available at early levels in mind.
-Grabbing skill is now set to J key by default.
-Dash skill is now an alternative mode for Ruthlessness - Impulsiveness weapon.
-Ruthlessness - Impulsiveness weapon is now added to the shop.
-Some monsters sprites have been replaced.
-Interface graphical improvements have been made.
-Fixed some type errors.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1
-Added Story mode. In this mode the character isn’t pushed back when hit and the damage received from the enemies is reduced.
-Walljump and wallslide are now available right from the start.
-Fixed the bug in which character sometimes didn’t take damage if stayed close to the enemy.
-Fixed the bug in which musical tracks overlapped in two dialogues.
-Fixed the unskippable epilogue bug.
-Fast fullscreen key is now F7.
-Some minor difficulty tweaks.
-More currency dropped by monsters.
-Souls now give you both currency and energy.
